origin.summary: Route-readiness review found reusable Aegis primitives but no durable stores, policy domain, server adapters, or production identity integration for security management dispatch routes.

events.note: Recorded the route-enablement prerequisites and supported security management method contract without authorizing implementation.
Implementation authorized. Initial policy language is exact tool-name grant policy with priority and deny-overrides semantics.

Implemented the management dispatch surface, durable JDBC stores, OIDC claim mapping/configuration, policy evaluation, audit events, and focused tests. Live issuer deployment validation remains configuration-owned.
